intro: The Mysterious Fossil is an ancient specimen unearthed along the coast of Darkshore by Prospector Remtravel. Its curious characteristics have drawn the intense curiosity of the dwarven Explorers' League, prompting scholars to shuttle it across the sea to uncover its hidden secrets.

p: While conducting fieldwork among the wild shores of Darkshore, Prospector Remtravel uncovered a fossil unlike the common petrified stone scattered across Kalimdor. Deeming it of monumental historical importance, Remtravel arranged for the specimen to be delivered to dwarven scholars rather than let it languish in the wilderness. When brought before Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus, the relic immediately stood out as an extraordinary find.
